expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.U===2 && S.d===4 && S.q===2 && S.x===0 && S.h===2 && S.kentta==='viivat' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: U = 2,0 kV, d = 4,0 cm, q = +2,0 nC, x = 0, h = 2,0 cm, field lines shown (must run before any setup)
on load: F = 2,0 nC · 5,0e4 V/m = 100 µN (lesson-answers sim-F)
on load: E at the ball equals U : d = 5,0e4 V/m (computed from the plate charges, not set)
one select: field lines, field vectors or none
DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='U,d,h,kentta,q,x' && P.U.unit==='kV' && P.d.unit==='cm' && P.q.unit==='nC' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares U (kV), d (cm), q (nC), x, h (cm) and kentta

expr: (() => { const t=document.querySelector('#sim-root .readout').textContent; return t.indexOf('Voima-anturi')>=0 && t.indexOf('V/m')<0 && t.indexOf('N/C')<0 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: the readout shows the sensor's force only, not the field strength (the student computes E = F : q)

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); return c.width>=600 && c.height>=400 ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas 600x400 (a single panel; labels grow on a narrow screen)
